ClaimComponent.description:
One structured component of an answer claim -- wraps an
`ExtractedField` (schemas/claim_comparison.py) with the two additional judgments
evidence-set construction needs: is this component load-bearing, and does covering
it depend on another component being resolved first.

dependencies.description: component_id values this component's resolution depends on, if any.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

source_span.description: Offset within the answer claim's text.
source_span.title: Source Span

ClaimComponent.title: ClaimComponent

ClaimSupportCandidateStatus.description:
A programmatic, pre-review classification linking one AnswerClaim to packed
evidence (schemas/trace.py::AnswerSupportEdge.candidate_support_status) --
deliberately not a final correctness verdict and never rendered as "the answer is
false/faithful/hallucinated" (docs/review-loop-implementation-plan.md, "Answer
claim extraction"). Kept as a field separate from the existing, reviewer-facing
`AnswerSupportEdge.support_status` so a programmatic linking pass can never masquerade
as a reviewer's judgment.
ClaimSupportCandidateStatus.title: ClaimSupportCandidateStatus

ComparisonFieldName.description:
The 17 structured field types `review/field_extraction.py` attempts to extract
from a claim or candidate passage, per
docs/claim-linking-improvement-plan.md §2. Not every field fires on every text --
a field this extractor finds no signal for is `ABSENT` (ComparisonOutcome), not a
failure.
ComparisonFieldName.title: ComparisonFieldName

ComparisonOutcome.description:
The four-state field-comparison lattice
(docs/claim-linking-improvement-plan.md §3). ABSENT and UNKNOWN are deliberately
distinct: ABSENT means the field is not expressed on at least one side (nothing to
compare); UNKNOWN means it may be expressed on both sides but cannot be compared
with sufficient confidence (extraction/normalization/scope uncertainty).
ComparisonOutcome.title: ComparisonOutcome

ComponentRequiredness.description:
Whether a `ClaimComponent` (schemas/evidence_set.py) is load-bearing for the
claim -- docs/multi-passage-evidence-plan.md §4. CRITICAL components must be
covered by some member of a candidate evidence set for composite support to be
considered valid; INFORMATIONAL components (currently just cross-references) are
never themselves treated as blocking.
ComponentRequiredness.title: ComponentRequiredness

EvidenceSetConflict.description: One detected incompatibility between two members of a candidate set.
EvidenceSetConflict.title: EvidenceSetConflict

EvidenceSetConstructionMethod.description:
How an EvidenceSet was assembled -- docs/multi-passage-evidence-plan.md §9.
Always deterministic/programmatic in this pass; the enum exists so a future
semantic-assisted method (§"OPTIONAL SEMANTIC LAYER") has a place to be recorded
without a schema change.
EvidenceSetConstructionMethod.title: EvidenceSetConstructionMethod

EvidenceSetMember.description: One packed ContextItem's role within a candidate EvidenceSet.

field_comparisons.description: This member's own field comparisons against the claim (its individual candidate assessment).
field_comparisons.title: Field Comparisons

selection_rationale.description: Bounded, reviewer-facing reason this member was included.
selection_rationale.title: Selection Rationale

supplied_component_ids.description: component_id values (from the parent EvidenceSet.claim_components) this member covers at MATCH.
supplied_component_ids.title: Supplied Component Ids

EvidenceSetMember.title: EvidenceSetMember

ExtractionStatus.description:
Outcome of attempting to extract one ComparisonFieldName from one text.
Distinct from ComparisonOutcome (which compares two sides) -- this describes one
side's extraction attempt only.
ExtractionStatus.title: ExtractionStatus

FieldComparison.description: One field's four-state comparison outcome between a claim and a candidate.

explanation.description: A bounded, single-field explanation -- never a truth claim.
explanation.title: Explanation

mismatch_type.description: Set only when outcome=MISMATCH -- never implies contradiction by itself.

FieldComparison.title: FieldComparison

MismatchType.description:
Classification of a MISMATCH-outcome FieldComparison
(docs/claim-linking-improvement-plan.md §4). A mismatch is never automatically a
contradiction -- that inference is relationship classification's job, under
stricter conditions (see ClaimSupportCandidateStatus.CONTRADICTION_CANDIDATE).
MismatchType.title: MismatchType

description:
A candidate proposal that 2 (or, bounded, 3) packed items jointly cover the
components one AnswerClaim requires -- never a factual adjudication, never written
back onto AnswerSupportEdge (docs/multi-passage-evidence-plan.md §5).

construction_rationale.description: Bounded, reviewer-facing summary of why this set was proposed.
construction_rationale.title: Construction Rationale

covered_component_ids.description: component_id values covered at MATCH by the union of members.
covered_component_ids.title: Covered Component Ids

explanation.description: Bounded reviewer-facing text -- never a truth claim.
explanation.title: Explanation

redundant_component_ids.description: component_id values covered by more than one member (recorded, not an error).
redundant_component_ids.title: Redundant Component Ids

unresolved_component_ids.description: critical component_id values no member covers, or only UNKNOWN.
unresolved_component_ids.title: Unresolved Component Ids

title: EvidenceSet
